decisions.reason: The desk system remains tightly connected to the firm's office, conference, and configurable-system knowledge, so its strong absorptive capacity still supports incremental refinement and commercialization despite some portfolio-renewal risk.

A chair family is still close enough to the core furniture competence that the firm can continue learning from customer feedback and updating design and materials without straining its knowledge base.

The floor cushions are learnable but niche, and after several years the firm is likely to redirect resources toward stronger core categories and newer developments where its absorptive capacity yields clearer commercial returns.
The high standing table fits the firm's workplace and flexible-interior trajectory well, and existing product-development and materials capabilities make continued adaptation relatively easy.

The rug collection is still more distant from the firm's core know-how, but because it supports the broader interior concept and has had time to benefit from accumulated learning, management would be inclined to retain it while monitoring it closely.
